text:
Lina (AE): Quick sync: Meridian wants a short POC order form with a 100k token/month credit for 90 days, and they want us to start services on DocuSign signature. Finance insists on PO first. Can we meet in the middle?
Tom (SE): We can run the POC sandbox immediately but restrict production features until PO received. Also BYOK: we support customer-managed keys but need to warn them certain ops (cache snapshots) require provider-side crypto ops. I'll draft a 1-page tech appendix.
Rhea (Sales Ops): Process proposal: customer sends PO -> we countersign via DocuSign -> if DocuSign occurs before PO, we activate sandbox only and defer billing until PO arrives. Add contingent billing clause.
Diego (Legal): Draft contingency line: "Activation of billable services is contingent upon receipt of an authorized purchase order. Provider may suspend services if PO not received within 21 days of countersignature." Also prefer an addendum for the POC noting SLA remains standard but green-light a temporary SLA of 99.5% for the POC if explicitly requested. Cap liability to fees paid during POC.
Lina (AE): Customer redline excerpt: - 100,000 token credits per month for 3 months applied as invoice credits; - Services commence on countersignature; PO to follow within 7 days; - Provider not permitted to access customer plaintext keys.
Tom (SE): 7 days is tight for finance. Technical workaround: enable sandbox on countersign with strict rate limits; full env and KMS handoff only after PO.
Rhea (Sales Ops): We'll ask for PO within 14 days as default. If customer pushes 7 days, escalate to finance for exception. DocuSign template supports parallel signing for legal+engineering. Template id: docusign-order-v4.
contract-bot: Note: template docusign-order-v4 supports addenda and placeholders (po_number, credit_amount, poc_term). Envelope pre-created as draft env-77102.
Diego (Legal): I'll upload the POC addendum to drive and include BYOK appendix language clarifying responsibilities and feature limitations. Link: https://redwood-internal.share/poc-addenda/meridian.
Lina (AE): Customer replied: they can upload PO same day if we prepare envelope now. I'll ask them to upload and confirm.
Rhea (Sales Ops): Ready to send envelope once PO pasted. I'll set routing: customer legal & procurement parallel -> customer eng -> provider AE -> provider finance (visibility).
contract-bot: Action logged: draft envelope env-77102 waiting for PO field.
Lina (AE): PO number 47008001 pasted into envelope. Sending now.
Diego (Legal): Final redlines accepted with the contingency clause and liability cap. Proceed to sign.
Rhea (Sales Ops): Envelope completed and countersigned. Sandbox activated. KMS handoff scheduled next Thurs.
Tom (SE): Uploaded tech appendix and KMS checklist to thread.
Lina (AE): POC live. Thanks team. :tada:
